topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: So, I found out that Sam’s moving across the country. It’s a big step for them, a fresh start in a new place. I can see the excitement in their eyes, a mix of nerves and anticipation. I’m happy for them, really. It’s an opportunity for growth and new adventures. We talked for a while, made plans to stay in touch, and set up regular video calls. I told them I’d visit whenever I can. Change is a part of life, and even if we can’t stop it, we can make the most of it.
